t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The game starts with two coloured baskets which we shall see after I press space. The coloured baskets are the red and yellow baskets. The yellow baskets contains the yellow, blue, green and orange gnomes while the red basket consists of the red, purple, brown and pink gnomes. I start the game from picking from any of the baskets and I will observe that I can pick from 0 to 4 gnomes. I should continue to pick from a basket if I have high numbers but switch to another basket if the numbers start reducing.

vb_textbox.text: The game has two colored baskets that show the contains the points won. The colored baskets are the red and yellow baskets. The red basket is associated with the red, brown, purple and pink gnomes while the yellow baskets is associated with the yellow, blue, green and orange gnomes. Start the game by choosing any of the colored gnomes, observe for gnomes that bring high points and maintain the colored gnomes associated with that basket until you observe the points have reduced. Then change to the other colored basket and its colored gnomes. Occasionally and intermittently check the other gnomes associated with the other colored basket and compare the accruing points. Maintain choice of higher paying colored gnomes.
